label: Brother HL-L8360CDW
description: Brother HL-L8360CDW is a single-function colour laser printer at 33 ppm (Letter) / 31 ppm (A4) with automatic duplex, a 2.7-inch colour touchscreen and 512 MB of memory, the wired-or-wireless half of Brother's L8300 colour series. It has one RJ45 10Base-T/100Base-TX/1000Base-T port plus a single 802.11b/g/n 2.4 GHz radio supporting infrastructure and Wi-Fi Direct, and no PoE.
notes: From Brother's own specification page: LAN '10Base-T/100Base-TX/1000Base-T'; Wireless LAN 'IEEE 802.11b/g/n (Infrastructure Mode), IEEE 802.11g/n (Wi-Fi Direct)'; 512 MB memory (HL-L8360CDW); print speed 33 ppm Letter / 31 ppm A4; power source 220-240 VAC 50/60 Hz on the UK/EU sheet. The radio is 2.4 GHz only - no 5 GHz band - which is the usual reason a printer ends up on the guest SSID instead of the office one. Wireless speed is modelled as 300M, the 802.11n 2.4 GHz ceiling, because Brother publishes no PHY rate: this is a modelled figure, not a datasheet one. USB 2.0 host/device ports exist and are deliberately not modelled. No PoE.
